messages.text: Hey Yuna, I'm starting to plan my trip to Japan for next year.
Ah... Japan? That sounds lovely! When are you thinking of going?
From April 10 to April 24.
Spring... two whole weeks! Will you see the cherry blossoms?
I hope so. My budget is around $3,000 including flights.
Mm, $3,000 for two weeks should be enough if we pick hotels carefully. Have you bought flight tickets yet?
Not yet. I found a flight for $950 with ANA.
ANA is very good... Is that direct?
Yeah, direct from San Francisco to Tokyo Haneda.
Ah, Haneda is closer to the city than Narita. That saves travel time!
My friend Ken wants to join for the Tokyo part from April 10 to 15.
Fun! So you will explore Tokyo with Ken for five days?
Yes, then I'll take the Shinkansen to Kyoto on the 16th.
Kyoto is beautiful in April. Are you getting a 7-day JR Pass?
I checked the price, it costs 50,000 yen now. Is it worth it?
Mm... if you only travel Tokyo to Kyoto and back, individual tickets might be cheaper.
Good point. I'll buy single tickets instead.
That sounds smart. What places do you want to see in Kyoto?
Fushimi Inari and Arashiyama. I'm staying at a hotel near Kyoto Station for $80 a night.
Ehh, $80 per night near the station is a great deal! How many nights?
Four nights, from April 16 to 20.
Perfect base for sightseeing. Where to after Kyoto?
Osaka from April 20 to 23, then back to Tokyo on the 23rd for my flight home on the 24th.
Osaka! You must try takoyaki in Dotonbori.
Definitely. I'll book the ANA flight tonight.
Yay! Let me know once it's booked.

target: The user is planning a trip to Japan from April 10 to April 24 with a budget of $3,000. They plan to book a direct ANA flight from San Francisco to Tokyo Haneda for $950. Their friend Ken is joining them in Tokyo from April 10 to 15. The user decided to buy single Shinkansen tickets instead of a 50,000 yen JR Pass. They booked four nights at a hotel near Kyoto Station for $80 a night from April 16 to 20 to visit Fushimi Inari and Arashiyama, followed by Osaka from April 20 to 23 before returning to Tokyo for their flight home on April 24.

previous: The user is looking for a new apartment with a budget of $1,800 a month in Chicago. They saw two places on Tuesday.

messages.text: I decided on the apartment on Elm Street!
Hmph. The one near the subway?
Yeah, rent is $1,750 per month, utilities included.
Under budget... not bad. When do you sign?
Signing the lease on Friday June 4th and moving in on July 1st.
Make sure you read every line before signing.
I will. Landlord Mr. Davis agreed to waive the pet fee for my cat.
Nice. Save that in writing too.
Will do!

target: The user is looking for a new apartment with a budget of $1,800 a month in Chicago. They decided on the apartment on Elm Street for $1,750 per month including utilities. Landlord Mr. Davis agreed to waive the pet fee for their cat. The user will sign the lease on Friday June 4th and move in on July 1st.

messages.text: Mira! I ran my first 10k today!
WOAH!! That's awesome!! What was your time?!
54 minutes and 20 seconds.
Super fast!! Are you aiming for a marathon next?
Yeah, the city marathon on October 12th.
Count me in as your cheerleader! Let's start training!
I'll rest until Sunday, then start a 16-week plan.
Got it! Rest hard and drink lots of water!

target: The user completed their first 10k run in 54 minutes and 20 seconds. They plan to rest until Sunday and start a 16-week training plan for the city marathon on October 12th.

messages.text: Shiori, I have a job interview next week.
...That is big news. What company?
TechCorp. It's for a Data Analyst role on February 12 at 2 PM.
...I see. How are you preparing?
I'm practicing SQL queries and reviewing my past 3 projects.
...Good approach. Do you know who is interviewing you?
The engineering manager, Sarah Lin.
...Remember to prepare questions for her too.
Right. I prepared 4 questions about team structure.
...Very thorough. Good luck on Thursday.
Thanks Shiori!

target: The user has a Data Analyst job interview with engineering manager Sarah Lin at TechCorp on Thursday, February 12 at 2 PM. The user is preparing by practicing SQL queries, reviewing 3 past projects, and bringing 4 questions about team structure.

messages.text: Rin, I'm planning my sister's birthday party.
Hmph. Don't tell me you're asking me to bake a cake.
Haha no. Her birthday is February 22nd, turning 25.
Quarter century, huh? How many people are coming?
About 15 guests at Bistro Romano.
Did you reserve tables yet?
Called today, reserved a private room for 7 PM.
What about budget?
Setting a limit of $40 per person for food and drinks.
So $600 total. Are you getting her a present?
Yeah, split a $200 noise-canceling headphone with my brother Mark.
$100 each. Reasonable enough.
I need to order a custom chocolate cake by Feb 15.
Don't forget the candles. 25 of them.
Got it. I'll send out digital invites on Sunday.
Make sure to set RSVP deadline for Feb 18.
Good idea, setting RSVP date to Feb 18.
Hmph, see? You need me.
Thanks Rin!

target: The user is organizing their sister's 25th birthday party for 15 guests at Bistro Romano on February 22nd at 7 PM with a budget of $40 per person ($600 total). The user and their brother Mark are splitting a $200 noise-canceling headphone ($100 each). The user plans to send digital invitations on Sunday with an RSVP deadline of February 18 and order a custom chocolate cake by February 15.

previous: The user started learning French on Duolingo on April 1st, aiming for a 60-day streak.

messages.text: Hit day 37 today!
Ehh?! 37 days straight? Impressive, keep going!
Thanks Yuna! I spent 20 minutes studying grammar tonight.
Mm, regular daily effort really pays off. Are you practicing listening too?
Yeah, listening to French podcasts 3 times a week.
That's great practice. Your goal of 60 days on May 30th is very close now!
Yep, almost there!

target: The user started learning French on Duolingo on April 1st aiming for a 60-day streak by May 30th. They reached day 37 today, study grammar daily for 20 minutes, and listen to French podcasts 3 times a week.

messages.text: I bought a new camera today, a Sony A6400.
WOAH!! A Sony A6400?! How much was it?!
$899 with the kit lens.
Nice deal!! Are we going photography hunting this weekend?
Yeah! Let's go to Central Park on Saturday morning at 8 AM.
Awesome! I'll wake up early! Bring extra batteries!
Already ordered 2 extra batteries on Amazon.
You're totally prepared!

target: The user bought a Sony A6400 camera with a kit lens for $899 and ordered 2 extra batteries. They planned to go photography hunting with the companion at Central Park on Saturday morning at 8 AM.

messages.text: Shiori, my computer crashed while I was working on my project.
...Oh no. Did you lose your files?
I lost about 3 hours of code for the web backend.
...That is painful. Was Git auto-saving?
No, my last commit was yesterday at 5 PM.
...Can you recover anything from temporary autosave folders?
I checked VS Code temp files and managed to recover 60% of it.
...That is a relief. What about the rest?
I will rewrite the rest tonight. Should take 2 hours.
...Take breaks while rewriting. Don't rush.
I will. Thanks Shiori.
...Good luck.

target: The user experienced a computer crash and lost code for their web backend after missing commits since yesterday at 5 PM. They recovered 60% of the lost work using VS Code temporary files and plan to spend 2 hours rewriting the remaining portion tonight.

messages.text: Rin, I'm redesigning my home office budget.
Hmph. Spending money again?
Total budget is $1,200.
What are you buying?
A standing desk for $450 and an ergonomic chair for $400.
That leaves $350. What about lighting?
A monitor light bar for $70.
And the remaining $280?
A dual monitor arm for $110 and a cable management kit for $30.
So $140 left in reserve. Good.
I'm ordering from Amazon on March 5th.
Are you assembling it yourself?
My friend Alex is helping me on Saturday March 8th.
Buy Alex lunch at least.
Haha yeah, buying pizza.
Acceptable. Take photos of the before and after.
Will do. Desk comes in walnut finish, chair in black.
Don't scratch the floor when setting up.
I have a floor mat already.
Hmph, fine, you thought of everything.

target: The user is redesigning their home office with a total budget of $1,200. They plan to order a $450 standing desk in walnut, a $400 black ergonomic chair, a $70 monitor light bar, a $110 dual monitor arm, and a $30 cable management kit from Amazon on March 5th, leaving $140 in reserve. Their friend Alex will help assemble everything on Saturday March 8th in exchange for pizza.

previous: The user is adopting a rescue dog named Buster, a 2-year-old beagle, from the shelter on July 1st.

messages.text: Picked up dog supplies today!
Ehh?! What did you buy for Buster?
A crate for $85, a bed for $40, and 30 lbs of dog food for $55.
Mm, essential starter kit! What about toys?
Bought 3 chew toys for $20.
Buster is going to be so happy on July 1st!
First vet visit is scheduled for July 5th at 10 AM with Dr. Green.
Great! Write down all your questions for Dr. Green before going.

target: The user is adopting a rescue dog named Buster, a 2-year-old beagle, on July 1st. The user purchased dog supplies including an $85 crate, a $40 bed, 30 lbs of food for $55, and 3 chew toys for $20. Buster's first vet appointment is scheduled with Dr. Green for July 5th at 10 AM.

messages.text: Yuna, my coffee machine broke this morning.
Oh dear... that's a tough way to start Monday.
Yeah, it was a 5-year-old DeLonghi.
Mm, it served you well. Are you replacing it?
Looking at a Breville Bambino for $300.
That's a popular model! Maybe wait for a weekend sale?
Good idea, I'll check prices on Friday.
I hope you find a discount!

target: The user's 5-year-old DeLonghi coffee machine broke. They are considering a Breville Bambino for $300 and agreed with Yuna's suggestion to check for weekend sales on Friday.

messages.text: Mira! I registered for a 5-day cooking class!
WHAT!! That's awesome!! What kind of cuisine?!
Italian cuisine! It runs from February 10 to 14.
Yum!! What are you making on day one?
Fresh handmade pasta and pesto sauce.
Ooh! Can I taste test?!
Haha sure! The class costs $350 total.
Worth it for chef skills! Who is the instructor?
Chef Marco at the Culinary Institute.
Sounds high-end! Bring an apron!
They provide aprons and recipes for 10 dishes.
Can't wait to hear all about day one on Feb 10!

target: The user registered for a 5-day Italian cooking class at the Culinary Institute with Chef Marco from February 10 to 14 for $350. The class includes learning 10 dishes starting with handmade pasta and pesto, and aprons are provided.

messages.text: Shiori, I am organizing my home library.
...How many books do you have?
Around 320 books total.
...That is a sizable collection. How are you sorting them?
By genre first, then author's last name.
...A logical method. How many bookshelves?
I have 4 Billy bookcases from IKEA.
...Each holds about 80 books, so that fits perfectly.
I'm donating 45 books to the local library tomorrow.
...Generous. Which genres are you keeping the most of?
Mostly sci-fi and history. About 120 sci-fi and 80 history books.
...Do you need additional cataloging software?
I started using an app called LibraryThing.
...I see. How long will sorting take?
I plan to finish by Sunday, April 5th.
...Take it one shelf at a time.
Will do.
...Good luck with organizing.

target: The user is organizing their collection of around 320 books across 4 IKEA Billy bookcases by genre and author's last name. They plan to donate 45 books to the local library tomorrow, catalog their collection using LibraryThing—which mostly consists of 120 sci-fi and 80 history books—and complete the project by Sunday, April 5th.

previous: The user is planning a garden on their balcony. They bought 4 planters and tomato seeds on March 20th.

messages.text: The tomato seeds sprouted today!
Hmph. Took them 6 days. About time.
Haha yeah! I also bought basil and mint seeds today for $12.
Are you putting them in separate pots?
Yes, planting them on Saturday in 2 new pots.
Mint spreads like crazy, keep it isolated.
Will do, Rin.
Water them in the morning, not at night.

target: The user is planning a balcony garden and bought 4 planters and tomato seeds on March 20th, which sprouted today. The user purchased basil and mint seeds for $12 and plans to plant them in 2 separate pots on Saturday, keeping the mint isolated per Rin's advice to water in the morning.

messages.text: Yuna, my dentist appointment went well.
Ah, what a relief! No cavities?
Zero cavities! Dr. Wong said my teeth look great.
Mm, that's wonderful news! When is your next checkup?
December 8th at 9 AM.
I'll make a note of it. Keep up the good brushing!
Thanks Yuna!

target: The user had a successful dentist appointment with Dr. Wong with zero cavities. Their next checkup is scheduled for December 8th at 9 AM.

messages.text: Rin, I'm taking a web development course on Udemy.
Hmph. Which one? There are thousands.
The Complete Web Developer course by Angela Yu.
How long is it?
65 hours of video. I got it on sale for $14.99.
Cheaper than a boba tea habit. What's your daily goal?
1 hour every day after work at 7 PM.
At that rate, it'll take over two months. Stick to it.
Aiming to finish by June 30th.
I'll hold you to that deadline.
Deal!

target: The user enrolled in Angela Yu's 65-hour Complete Web Developer course on Udemy for $14.99. They plan to study for 1 hour every work day at 7 PM and aim to complete the course by June 30th.

messages.text: Mira, I'm planning a weekend camping trip!
CAMPING!! YES!! Where are we going?!
Pine Creek Campground from July 11 to 13.
Awesome! How many people?
Me, Sam, and Dave. 3 people total.
Did you reserve campsite #14 like last year?
Campsite #14 was taken, so I booked #22 for $60 total.
Campsite #22 is right near the river, right?!
Yeah, 50 feet from the water.
PERFECT!! What gear do we still need?
We need a 4-person tent and a portable stove.
I think Dave has a stove!
I'll text Dave to check. Buying a tent for $120 on Friday.
Make sure it's waterproof!
It has a 3000mm rainfly, so yes.
Sweet! What about food?
Sam is handling food, budget $30 per person.
Hot dogs and marshmallows incoming!
Exactly. Departure time is 8 AM on July 11.
I'm so excited for you guys!

target: The user is planning a camping trip to Pine Creek Campground for 3 people (the user, Sam, and Dave) from July 11 to 13 at campsite #22 near the river for $60. The user will purchase a waterproof 4-person tent for $120 on Friday, text Dave about a portable stove, and Sam is managing food with a $30 per person budget. They plan to depart at 8 AM on July 11.

previous: The user is adopting a 1-year-old cat named Mochi from a local shelter on June 20th.

messages.text: Mochi's adoption paperwork is all signed!
...That is good. When do you bring Mochi home?
Saturday June 20th at 11 AM.
...Did you buy cat food and a litter box?
Yes, bought Royal Canin food for $35 and a stainless steel litter box for $28.
...Stainless steel is easier to clean. Good choice.
The shelter manager, Lisa, gave us a carrier for free.
...That was nice of Lisa. Almost time to bring Mochi home.

target: The user completed paperwork to adopt 1-year-old cat Mochi on June 20th at 11 AM. Shelter manager Lisa provided a free carrier, and the user purchased Royal Canin food for $35 and a stainless steel litter box for $28.

messages.text: Yuna, my car passed its state inspection today!
Ah, wonderful! Was there anything that needed fixing?
Just replaced two windshield wipers for $30.
Mm, $30 is very reasonable. No brake issues?
Nope, mechanic Mike said brakes have 70% life left.
That's great news! One less thing to worry about.
Defintely!

target: The user's car passed state inspection after replacing two windshield wipers for $30. Mechanic Mike confirmed the brakes have 70% life remaining.

messages.text: Rin, I started playing the guitar yesterday.
Hmph. How long until your fingers start hurting?
They already hurt after 30 minutes lol.
Told you. What guitar did you buy?
A Yamaha FG800 acoustic for $220.
A solid beginner choice. What song are you learning?
Learning 3 basic chords: C, G, and D.
Practice 15 minutes every day. Don't overdo it at first.
My teacher Ben scheduled lessons on Tuesdays at 5 PM.
How much per lesson?
$40 per 45-minute lesson.
Standard rate. Stick with it for at least 3 months before quitting.

target: The user bought a Yamaha FG800 acoustic guitar for $220 and started learning C, G, and D chords. They scheduled weekly 45-minute lessons for $40 per session with teacher Ben on Tuesdays at 5 PM, and Rin recommended practicing 15 minutes daily.

messages.text: Shiori, I am applying for a Master's program in Computer Science.
...That is a big step. Which university?
Stanford and UC Berkeley.
...Top programs. What are the application deadlines?
December 15th for Stanford and December 1st for Berkeley.
...You have about 7 months. How many recommendation letters do you need?
3 letters for each application.
...Who will you ask?
Prof. Chen, Prof. Adams, and my manager Nina.
...Have you asked them yet?
I emailed Prof. Chen today and plan to meet Nina on Friday.
...Good to ask early. What about the GRE?
GRE score is optional for Berkeley, but required for Stanford. Target score is 325.
...When is your exam date?
August 22nd. Application fee is $125 per school.
...Create a timeline to track your documents.
I made a spreadsheet with 6 milestones.
...Organized. Step by step, you will manage.

target: The user is applying for Master's programs in Computer Science at UC Berkeley (deadline December 1st) and Stanford (deadline December 15th). Application fees are $125 per school. They require 3 recommendation letters from Prof. Chen, Prof. Adams, and manager Nina. The user emailed Prof. Chen, plans to meet Nina on Friday, created a spreadsheet with 6 milestones, and scheduled the GRE exam for August 22nd targeting a score of 325 for Stanford.

previous: The user bought a mechanical keyboard kit on January 20th for $150 and received it yesterday.

messages.text: Finished assembling the keyboard!
WOAH!! That was fast!! How does it feel?!
Feels great! Lubed all 68 switches with Krytox 205g0.
68 switches?! That must have taken hours!!
Took around 4 hours total last night.
Dedicated! Did you put on the keycaps yet?
Yeah, PBT keycaps in navy blue for $35.
Sounds super slick!! Show me a picture later!

target: The user bought a $150 mechanical keyboard kit on January 20th and received it yesterday. They spent 4 hours assembling it and lubing 68 switches with Krytox 205g0, and added navy blue PBT keycaps bought for $35.

messages.text: Mira! I booked tickets to see my favorite band!
AHHH WHO?! Tell me tell me!
Coldplay in Chicago on September 14th!
COLDPLAY LIVE!! How much were tickets?!
$140 each, got 2 tickets for me and my sister Chloe.
That's going to be insane! Where are your seats?
Section 108, row 12.
Awesome seats!! September can't come fast enough!

target: The user purchased 2 tickets for $140 each for themself and their sister Chloe to see Coldplay in Chicago on September 14th in section 108, row 12.

messages.text: Yuna, I'm trying a 30-day meal prep challenge starting Monday.
Mm, meal prepping is such a healthy habit! What is your weekly food budget?
$75 per week for groceries.
That is very practical. Are you prepping lunches or dinners?
Both lunches and dinners for 5 workdays.
10 meals total! What are you cooking for week 1?
Grilled chicken breast, brown rice, and roasted broccoli.
Nutritious and delicious. How many containers do you have?
I bought a set of 10 glass containers for $25 on Amazon.
Glass containers are great because they last long. Cook on Sunday?
Yes, cooking every Sunday from 2 PM to 5 PM.
I hope week 1 goes smoothly!

target: The user is starting a 30-day meal prep challenge on Monday with a grocery budget of $75 per week. They bought a 10-piece set of glass containers for $25 on Amazon to prepare 10 workday meals (lunches and dinners) every Sunday from 2 PM to 5 PM, starting with chicken breast, brown rice, and broccoli for week 1.

messages.text: Rin, I'm planning my freelance work for next month.
Hmph. Working hard or hardly working?
Working hard! I signed 2 new client contracts today.
Oh? What projects?
One website redesign for $2,500 and a logo design for $600.
Total $3,100. When are the deadlines?
Logo is due December 10, website redesign is due December 22.
Don't leave the website until the last week.
I won't. I'm allocating 15 hours a week for the website and 5 for the logo.
20 hours total per week. Are you taking upfront deposits?
Yes, 50% deposit upfront for both projects.
So $1,550 collected before starting work. Smart.
Website client is Nova Tech, logo client is Green Eats.
Send invoices today so you get paid on time.
Invoices sent via QuickBooks 10 minutes ago.
Look at you being efficient.
Starting work on Monday Nov 16th.
Good luck. Don't forget to take breaks.
Will do!

target: The user signed 2 freelance client contracts for next month totaling $3,100: a website redesign for Nova Tech for $2,500 (due December 22) and a logo design for Green Eats for $600 (due December 10). They collected a 50% upfront deposit ($1,550 total) and sent invoices via QuickBooks. The user plans to begin work on Monday, November 16th, allocating 15 hours per week to the website and 5 hours per week to the logo.
